summary: One independently testable behavior: the non-arena final descent sequence, whose altered rules/context make the final 5-10 min mechanically different from the approach (sections 23, 39) and which ends in the section-45 win condition as new simulation state. Three changed subsystems: simulation rules (altered-context activation triggered by WI-05a MacGuffin retrieval, the win-condition field set exactly once, one-shot trigger semantics), world content data (final layout, escape path, final decision point, altered rules), headless scenario tests (fresh-save: retrieve, enter sequence, assert altered rules active, assert no arena-boss structure, assert the trigger fires exactly once, per-step save/reload continues, determinism). Evidence is focused on a single headless scenario with a negative one-shot check and per-step reload checks, no rule mocks. The save boundary is self-consistent: per-step reload uses the existing save mechanism (SaveGameV1.world.storyFlags round-trips the win-condition and sequence-step state, as the sim already does for base-line flags), so no schema change is needed; the autosave extension and ending variants/credits/restart are explicitly deferred to WI-05c, and the private mechanism (WI-01c) is referenced by id only per spoiler rules. Depends on WI-05a (retrieval gates the sequence) and inherits ST-03/ST-04 via the parent story; no ancestor or descendant dependencies. AC-end-seq carried verbatim.
